newsitem.title: INDIA: Eight killed as India bus rams into train.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed as India bus rams into train.

text.p: A bus rammed past a railway crossing gate into a freight train in northern India on Saturday, killing at least eight people and injuring 25, the Press Trust of India reported.
The news agency said the accident occurred around 10.00 a.m. (0430 GMT) near Agra, some 200 km (125 miles) south of the Indian capital in the state of Uttar Pradesh.
